subject: website
name: Hoverfly Swarm upload
summary: The upload page for Hoverfly, a Swarm light client. Its source is public (MIT). It runs no third-party code and makes no request when it opens, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: its code hard-codes a Gnosis RPC endpoint, a Goldsky indexer for postage batches, the Gnosisscan API and 4byte, which it uses when the user uploads.

connections.name: Gnosis RPC (rpc.gnosischain.com)
connections.note: Used when the user uploads, without a light client.

connections.name: Postage batch indexer (api.goldsky.com)
connections.note: Queried when the user picks a postage batch.

connections.name: Gnosisscan and 4byte APIs
connections.note: Used to read transactions and decode calls.
